house.description: Prohibition extended on manufacturers interfering with access to 340B drugs.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Commerce Finance and Policy
Author changed Johnson, P., be shown as Chief Author

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to drug manufacturers; extending a prohibition on manufacturers interfering with access to 340B drugs; repealing Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 62J.96, subdivision 3.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+REPEALER. +]

[+Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 62J.96, subdivision 3,+]

[+ is repealed. +]

APPENDIX
Repealed Minnesota Statutes: 25-04475

62J.96 ACCESS TO 340B DRUGS.

Subd. 3.
Expiration.
This section expires July 1, 2027.
